supersedes_note: Corrective provenance erratum. Does NOT modify prior evidence files; it records that earlier V3 evidence carried a misleading install_mode label.
issue: Earlier V3 evidence (P2P-U cap200/cap400 and C4 records) recorded install_mode LOCK_EXACT_MAIN_PLUS_DEV (and V2_MAIN_PLUS_EXACT_LOCKED_DEV) while the actual task environment omitted historically-declared DEV/TEST packages. The poetry.lock 'category'/'groups' dev/test set was not installed because (a) the has_poetry+has_req install path installs requirements.txt main pins only, and (b) the modern poetry.lock (>=1.1) carries no per-package group metadata, so the legacy parser derived an empty dev set.

corrected_behavior.note: Env Closure V3.1 makes the install_mode label truthful: main recipe unchanged + exact historical DEV/TEST closure derived by rule (benchmark.wp2.dep_compiler) and installed as the additive supplement. install_mode still reflects the frozen semantic (LOCK_EXACT_MAIN_PLUS_DEV / V2_MAIN_PLUS_EXACT_LOCKED_DEV / uv), and the per-unit manifest now records main_recipe_signature + dev_test_closure{pins_sha256, n_pins} as ACTUAL-EFFECTIVE evidence (E3.6/E3.8).
